title: Jimmie Lunceford's band and teaching bassist Moses Allen
summary: Manno names Calloway and Lunceford as the only Black bands he knew and says he taught Lunceford's bassist Moses Allen.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: no I used to the only the only colored bands that I knew of course Cab Calloway and Jimmy Lunsford incidentally Jimmy Lunsford bass player Moses Allen was a student of mine I knew Jimmy quite well he was Prince the guy where was Moses Allen from do you know Memphis they were all from the same I can't remember which town they came from but the Lunsford band was a high school band and Lunsford was the band director and he organized them into this group and they were so good that they went out playing here and there and before long they went big time and they were all from the same school of course later on he had guys like Willie Smith and chew Barry and a bunch of those fellas come in but that but they weren't in the original band but Moses was and did you teach him after he'd been playing professional oh yes oh yes I taught Moses it must have been somewhere around 38 or 39 somewhere along in there he used to fly in take a lesson Jimmy would
finance it now I'd like to get a picture of that string bass with the scars on it
